SendRequestIn.description:
POST /api/v1/send 请求体；未知字段一律拒绝。

``to`` 是唯一的寻址字段，语义随 ``type`` 变化：email 是收件地址，ntfy 是
渠道列表里的完整 canonical topic，群机器人是各自的 opaque 目标标识。
目标必须是本账号已添加的渠道；省略 ``to`` 时投递该 ``type`` 匹配的已保存默认渠道。

内容：``body`` 与 ``html`` 必须且只能给一个。email 两者都接受（``html`` 原样
投递，不套服务模板）；ntfy 与群机器人只接受 ``body``。

info.description: Hosted email and ntfy notifications with a simple API-key flow: add a channel in the console, create a key, then send. Delivery is asynchronous: send requests return 201 with a log_id before background delivery; poll the status endpoint for the real result. A successful email target settles 10 Message Credits and an ntfy target 5; acceptance reserves Credits and known failures release them. Errors use a JSON envelope with a stable code, message and optional details. Guides and the public API reference are at /docs/.
info.title: Portcloud Notify

post.description:
Queue a notification without waiting for delivery.

`type` selects email or ntfy. `to` names one destination the account already
added — a verified email address for `type="email"`, or the channel list's
full canonical ntfy topic for `type="ntfy"`. Omit `to` to deliver only the
account's saved default channels matching `type` (no match: 400
NO_DEFAULT_CHANNEL). `title` is required. Email accepts exactly one of
plaintext `body` (rendered in the service template) or custom `html` (sent
verbatim without a service wrapper). ntfy requires `body` and rejects `html`.

Returns 201 with `{log_id, status: "queued"}` for the first target; each
target has its own log, and poll `GET /api/v1/send/{log_id}` for the result.

400.description: Unverified recipient/channel, missing defaults, or invalid message (RECIPIENT_NOT_VERIFIED / CHANNEL_UNVERIFIED / NO_DEFAULT_CHANNEL / INVALID_RECIPIENT_FORMAT / INVALID_PAYLOAD / VALIDATION_ERROR).

401.description: API key required, invalid, or expired (UNAUTHENTICATED / INVALID_API_KEY / API_KEY_EXPIRED).

403.description: Star eligibility refusal or disabled account (STAR_REQUIRED / USER_DISABLED).

404.description: An ntfy `to` that is not one of the account's channels, or a target owned by another account (NOT_FOUND).

429.description: Rate, Message Credits, or daily send-attempt limit exceeded (IP_RATE_LIMITED / RATE_LIMITED / MESSAGE_CREDITS_EXHAUSTED / DAILY_ATTEMPT_LIMIT_REACHED).

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before retrying, when provided.

503.description: Global Message Credits exhausted or dependency unavailable (GLOBAL_MESSAGE_CREDITS_EXHAUSTED / DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE).

post.description:
Send runtime content down the account's preset chain.

The account's single preset is resolved server-side, so the body carries
only `title` and plaintext `body`. Nodes are tried in order; a known
failure advances to the next node, and success or an uncertain result stops
the chain. Returns one log_id for the whole chain; poll
`GET /api/v1/send/{log_id}` for the terminal result.

400.description: No preset configured, invalid preset configuration, or unverified channel (NO_PRESET / CHANNEL_TARGET_INVALID / CHANNEL_UNVERIFIED / VALIDATION_ERROR).

401.description: API key required, invalid, or expired (UNAUTHENTICATED / INVALID_API_KEY / API_KEY_EXPIRED).

403.description: Star eligibility refusal or disabled account (STAR_REQUIRED / USER_DISABLED).

404.description: A channel referenced by the preset is missing or owned by another account (NOT_FOUND).

429.description: Rate, Message Credits, or daily send-attempt limit exceeded.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before retrying, when provided.

503.description: Global Message Credits exhausted, queue full, or dependency unavailable.
